measurement_source: valid canonical SWE-Verified exact4 Tail6 B1

method.description: Assign mandatory weight bytes from the corrected production ledger to the measured disjoint SFWD and DFWD GPU timers, then retain CFWD and outside-GPU wall time as nonweight work.
method.caution: Effective mandatory-byte rates are lower-bound accounting rates, not hardware-counter DRAM throughput. They identify the gap to the weight floor but do not by themselves prove a full roofline compute-versus-memory classification.

sfwd.assigned_work: target model plus full verifier head
sfwd.bound_assessment: weight-bandwidth floor dominates the lower bound; kernel counters are still required to separate bandwidth loss, compute, and launch gaps

dfwd.assigned_work: five MTP passes plus five 64k draft heads
dfwd.bound_assessment: weight-bandwidth floor dominates the lower bound; kernel counters are still required to separate head GEMM efficiency, MTP compute, and launch gaps

cfwd.assigned_work: tree acceptance, scan, and commit path
cfwd.bound_assessment: not classifiable as compute- or memory-bound from phase timers alone; requires counters collected during canonical real-task traffic

outside_gpu_components.bound_assessment: host launch, synchronization, and untimed runtime work

priority: SFWD target and verifier weight path
CFWD plus host launch and synchronization path
closure_math.conclusion: Perfect SFWD and DFWD weight streaming is insufficient by itself: CFWD plus outside-GPU work must also fall from 36.50 ms to at most 17.95 ms per event.
